arguments.command: set -euo pipefail; tag=nothingness_linux_debug2; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="$tag"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${tag}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${tag}"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_flutter_run_${tag}"; mkdir -p "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.config" "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.local/share"; rm -f "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"; mkfifo "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"; nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" > "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>&1 & pid=$!; echo "pid=$pid"; sleep 3; ls -l "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" || true; ps -p $pid -o pid,cmd || true; tail -n 5 "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" || true
